whatItIs: QSimulator.jl is an open-source project in the benchmarks and analysis category. It is maintained by BBN-Q and primarily looks like a Julia codebase. Unitary and Lindbladian evolution in Julia

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches benchmarks and analysis workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: Package for simulating time dynamics of quantum systems with a focus on superconducting qubits. We can track the code performance between commits by running the benchmarking suite in benchmark/benchmarks.jl using PkgBenchmark.
whoItsFor: Researchers and evaluators comparing toolchains, algorithms, hardware assumptions, or performance tradeoffs.

quickstart.source:
julia> import QSimulator

julia> using PkgBenchmark

julia> results = benchmarkpkg("QSimulator")
